description: Call this when an agent purchase is disputed, returned as wrong, or charged back and a Tethered Trust receipt exists for it: we assemble the evidence (the decision, products checked, sources with dates, the linked order or mandate, records and recall notices that changed since, reported outcomes, and signature verification) into one printable page and JSON anyone can verify. For merchants, platforms and buyers. $1.50 per packet.

receipt_id.description: The receipt id (rcpt_...) of the decision made before the purchase.
